subject.title: Feature Request: Remote Reranker Endpoint Support

question: Which remote-reranking product/API path should OpenClaw support: the concrete external-reranker plugin, the generic MemoryRerankProvider SDK seam, or ClawHub-only external plugins until a narrower core API gap is proven?
rationale: Current main does not implement the feature, but there are two overlapping open implementation directions and both affect public plugin/config/security boundaries that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Approve Generic SDK Seam First
options.body: Adopt the generic MemoryRerankProvider-style API and let concrete Cohere-compatible endpoint plugins ship separately after the public contract and security boundary are approved.

options.title: Sponsor The Concrete Endpoint Plugin
options.body: Continue with the external-reranker plugin path after repairing MMR config compatibility, dependency graph issues, docs, and remote memory-egress security review.

options.title: Defer To ClawHub For Now
options.body: Keep remote reranking as community/plugin work and only reopen a core change if an external implementation hits a specific missing SDK capability.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic SDK Seam First
recommendation.body: Adopt the generic MemoryRerankProvider-style API and let concrete Cohere-compatible endpoint plugins ship separately after the public contract and security boundary are approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for memory architecture, plugin boundary, and config-surface policy points to steipete as the best available owner for the product/API decision.
